correctness.rationale: The collision reduction follows directly from the multiplicative formula for \(J_5\): after cancellation, the signed valuation vector of the factors \(p^5-1\) must vanish modulo \(5\). The deletion lemma is an immediate coordinate argument. The attached verifier checks exact factorizations for every prime \(p\le50000\), primality of every displayed factor in the certified 64-bit range, and all four uniqueness-deletion rounds, which exhaust all \(5133\) candidate primes.

value.rationale: The source's main theorem uses the same largest-prime-factor invariant to quantify how far collisions are excluded for other exponents, so extending that invariant to the untreated exponent \(5\) addresses a motivated gap. The result excludes every collision supported on the first \(5133\) primes, by a complete exact certificate, rather than checking a bounded range of integer arguments.
